company: National Stock Exchange of India Limited
about: NSE is India's largest stock exchange by turnover, running a vertically integrated platform for trading, clearing (NSE Clearing), listing, indices (Nifty), data, colocation and licensing. It holds about 93% of cash market and 99.7% of equity futures turnover and serves 132.37 million unique registered investors and 3,005 listed entities (June 2026). It is a SEBI-regulated Market Infrastructure Institution based in Mumbai, with a GIFT City arm (NSEIX).

objects.purpose: Offer for Sale by selling shareholders (company receives no proceeds); listing on BSE/NSE

promoters.background: NSE has no identifiable promoter under SEBI ICDR; shares are held by institutions and the Offer is a sale by existing shareholders.

concentration.note: Revenue is heavily volume-linked: options transaction charges were Rs 9,997.57 crore, about 60% of FY26 revenue from operations.

litigation_note: Multiple SEBI show cause notices and enforcement matters, including OPG Securities (May 2023), TAP architecture and the Feb 2021 trading halt; amounts of 6,430.53 million and 726.48 million appear in the TAP matter text. Exact total exposure not stated in the extracted text.
strengths: Largest Indian exchange: 92.99% cash market, 99.79% equity futures and 74.71% equity options share in FY26.
Huge investor base: 132.37 million unique registered investors and 3,005 listed entities as of June 2026.
Very high margins: operating EBITDA margin 66.85% and PAT margin 50.98% in FY26.
Strong returns: RoNW 33.21% and ROE 32.98% in FY26, with essentially no borrowings.
Vertically integrated: trading, clearing, listing, indices (Nifty), data, colocation under one platform.
Core Settlement Guarantee Fund of Rs 13,079 crore at Mar-26 backs settlement safety; CRISIL AAA clearing corporation.
Proven technology: 21.89 billion peak order messages and 201 million trades handled in a day in March 2026.
Growing ecosystem: Total fund mobilisation of Rs 20.33 trillion in FY26 and 108 mainboard IPOs.

risks.title: Revenue depends on trading volumes
risks.detail: Earnings depend on trade volumes; options transaction charges were about 60% of FY26 revenue. Equity options premium ADTV fell from Rs 62,449 crore in FY25 to Rs 57,662 crore in FY26 and revenue fell 3.1% in FY26.

risks.title: Falling options market share
risks.detail: Equity options premium-turnover market share dropped from 96.86% in FY24 to 74.71% in FY26 and 68.48% in Q1 FY27.

risks.title: SEBI enforcement actions and penalties
risks.detail: NSE faces SEBI show cause notices and adjudication proceedings, including OPG Securities (2023), TAP architecture (matter figures 6,430.53 and 726.48 million) and the 2021 trading halt. Outcomes uncertain.

risks.title: Heavily regulated by SEBI and IFSCA
risks.detail: Inspections have produced observations, show cause notices, warnings and deficiency letters; rule changes on charges (true-to-label) can cut fees.

risks.title: Technology glitches and outages
risks.detail: Index lists past glitches in NSE and NSE Clearing systems (e.g. April 2026 commodity risk engine crash, Feb 2021 trading halt), risking penalties and reputation.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and market downturn risk
risks.detail: Slower GDP, inflation, higher rates, rupee weakness or a rating downgrade could cut investor participation and volumes.

risks.title: Valuation is full, no fresh capital
risks.detail: P/E of 42.89 on FY26 EPS of 41.62 at the Rs 1,785 offer price; entire Rs 22,561.57 crore is an Offer for Sale, so NSE receives nothing.

risks.title: Governance and compliance lapses
risks.detail: Past lapses include non-compliance when the Governing Board had only four directors after public interest directors' terms ended in Nov 2023, IPFT investment lapses, and delayed statutory dues.

notes: Rs million converted to Rs crore. Consolidated; FY = year to March. Q1 FY27 (June 2026) stub ignored. revenue=Revenue from operations; pbt=profit before tax from continuing operations incl. associates share and exceptional items; pat=profit for the year incl. discontinued ops (Rs 10,302.06 crore FY26; owners' EPS basis). PAT margin is the reported KPI (denominator includes associates income and discontinued revenue), so it is lower than pat/revenue. ebitda=reported Operating EBITDA (excl. other income). net_worth=equity attributable to owners (not ICDR net worth); reserves=other equity. cash_and_bank excludes Rs 30,146.66/15,879.89/21,327.11 crore of settlement and member margin money (FY26/25/24) held inside cash. No borrowings reported (only lease liabilities), operating cash flow not in provided text. Peer revenue is BSE FY26 revenue from operations. Offer price Rs 1,785 with Rs 170 employee discount; Offer Price band 1,700-1,785. Core SGF values are Rs million/10.
